_readme: Curated seed of REAL, publicly-filed planned projects — Savannah River corridor (Savannah + Augusta scenes). Every record cites a public source (SCRTP/SERTP plan docs, SC PSC dockets, GA ITS ten-year plan, IRPs). Coordinates verified against OSM power=* features and/or HIFLD junction analysis; see data/raw/filings/PROJECTS_EXTRACT.md for the underlying extraction and raw PDFs. location_confidence: verified = named facility coordinate confirmed; endpoint_only = straight line between verified endpoint substations; approximate = town/site centroid, exact pad site unpublished. NO fabricated entries.

projects.name: Jasper – Okatie 230 kV #2 (new line)
projects.notes: New 230 kV B1272 ACSR line, Jasper Sub (Hardeeville SC) -> Okatie 230/115 Sub. Endpoints: OSM Jasper Substation + 230kV junction cluster at -81.032,32.335.

projects.name: Okatie 230-115 kV substation expansion + Jasper–Yemassee #1 fold-in
projects.notes: Okatie Transmission sub expansion, 230-115 autobank; folds Jasper–Yemassee #1 in (becomes Jasper–Okatie #1 + Okatie–Yemassee). Junction cluster anchor.

projects.name: Okatie – Riverport 230 kV tap
projects.notes: 230 kV tap from Okatie to RiverPort industrial park, Hardeeville SC. RiverPort pad site unpublished — river-side industrial area approx.

projects.name: Okatie – McIntosh 115 kV SOCO Tie: series reactor + Deerfield Switching Station
projects.source: https://www.scrtp.com/assets/pdfs/home/2026-2030-2million-and-above-project-descriptions.pdf (Project 42 of 54, ISD 12/31/2028); SCRTP 2024-10-30 deck p.19 DESC5
projects.notes: 9% series reactor on the DESC<->GPC Okatie–McIntosh 115 kV tie + new Deerfield Switching Station. THE cross-river tie corridor — Okatie SC to Plant McIntosh GA.

projects.name: Okatie – McIntosh 115 kV line reconductor
projects.notes: Reconductor of the DESC<->SOCO 115 kV tie; ~6.3 mi of Jasper–Yemassee lines share ROW. Driver project for the 2026-175-E filing; ISD not published (window est. with 2026-175 work).

projects.name: Okatie – Bluffton 115 kV rebuild
projects.notes: Wood H-frames -> steel SPDC + 1272 ACSR, Okatie SC -> Bluffton SC.

projects.name: Reconductor all 230 kV lines out of Jasper (incl. Jasper–Yemassee #1&#2, Jasper–Purrysburg #1&#2)
projects.notes: B1272 ACSR->ACSS: Jasper–Yemassee #1 (38.16 mi) & #2 (37.95 mi), Jasper–Purrysburg #1&#2 (0.59 mi ea.), Jasper–Okatie #2 (6.6 mi); 4000A terminals at Jasper/Okatie/Yemassee.

projects.name: Jasper – McIntosh 230 kV line (deferred alternative)
projects.source: https://dms.psc.sc.gov/Attachments/Matter/9be1208b-209a-4827-9166-24ac7fe6b5d3 (Docket 2026-175-E p.4, Alternative B — evaluated w/ Southern Company & SCPSA, deferred)
projects.notes: Documented joint-line option ~3 mi across the river; DESC chose reconductor instead but flags it as future expansion strategy. Timeline unknown — flagged honestly.

projects.name: Urquhart – Toolebeck 115 kV rebuild

projects.name: Urquhart – Aiken PSA 46 kV rebuild

projects.name: Atomic Road 115-12 kV substation (new)
projects.notes: New distribution sub on Atomic Road corridor, Beech Island/Jackson SC.

projects.name: Jackson 115-12 kV distribution substation (new)

projects.name: Wagener 115 kV tap
projects.notes: 115 kV tap off Edmund Switching Station–Owens Corning line to new Wagener dist. sub. At north edge of Augusta scene.

projects.name: Stevens Creek – Graniteville 115 kV rebuild
projects.source: https://www.scrtp.com/assets/pdfs/home/2026-2030-2million-and-above-project-descriptions.pdf (Project 50 of 54, ISD 12/31/2029, ~15 mi, hurricane-damaged early-60s line)

projects.name: Urquhart Station replacement (retire 193 MW + RFP resource)

projects.name: Graniteville #2 – Sand Bar Ferry 115 kV SOCO Tie: 6% series reactor (study candidate)

projects.name: Bluffton – Purrysburg 230 kV limiting-elements replacement

projects.name: Purrysburg 230-115 kV transformer + station improvements

projects.name: Plant McIntosh Units 10-11 NGCC + 1A-8A CT upgrades

projects.name: McIntosh – Purrysburg 230 kV reactors (tie lines #1&#2)

projects.name: McIntosh 230 kV breaker control relay upgrades (20 breakers)

projects.name: West McIntosh 230 kV breakers + 115 kV autobank switch upgrades
